decisions.diagnosis: First day of the Ecocounter record: both directions read 0 through the whole working day while a few counts appear before and after, consistent with the unit being commissioned that day; the bikes that passed were not recorded and cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: Counter-wide zero 04:45-18:45 (13 daytime hours, usual ~556 bikes); day totals 18/41 vs 223/263 on the next day.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter outage: both directions report exactly 0 for 17 days while nearby CBD counters are busy, and counts resume mid-afternoon as after a repair; the riders passing were not counted and cannot be recovered.
Feed outage: both directions 0 for three days at the same time as neighbouring site 542 (also 0), so nothing was recorded and the counts cannot be recovered.
On scattered days (single days, later pairs of days) every one of the 4 channel records per slot was published twice, doubling the day's total; drop the exact repeats.
decisions.evidence: duplicates(): 28 runs per direction 2022-04-10..2024-11-30, 8 records/slot instead of 4, every extra record an exact repeat; those days have 0 odd slots and doubled() level ~1.4-2.4 (e.g. 338 2024-10-10 1016 vs 373-429 neighbouring days).

decisions.diagnosis: Ecocounter failed: both directions report 0 for ten weeks while neighbours (542, 551, 543) keep counting; the riders were not recorded and cannot be recovered (a single normal-looking day 2025-06-17 follows, then the record ends).
decisions.evidence: Daily 670/775 on 2025-04-07, then 0/0 every day to 2025-06-16; 542 1800-2100/day, 543 1200-1500/day on the same weekdays; 2025-06-17 557/650 with a normal AM/PM profile.

decisions.diagnosis: Network-wide feed outage: 37 sites including 544, 546 and 542 report 0 on this day, so nothing was recorded and the day cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: 545 0/0 on 2025-10-23 between 1327 and 1175 on adjacent days; network(): 37 zero sites, 39 warning sites that day vs 0-3 on neighbouring days.

decisions.diagnosis: Metrocount stopped counting on a Friday afternoon: both directions 0 through the PM peak and evening apart from 7 bikes 18:30-19:00, while nearby counters recorded their usual evening peak; the counts cannot be recovered.

series.name: Northbound (citybound), Ecocounter
series.evidence: Ecocounter North, AM-peak profile (8am 126/h). Kept separate from Metrocount 1753: the Metrocount reads ~25-35% higher and relatively much higher off-peak (e.g. 10am 30 vs 22/h, 1754 midnight 11 vs 5.5/h) after a 4-month gap, and every neighbouring counter was replaced at the same time, so real growth cannot be separated from a change in detection.

series.evidence: Ecocounter South, PM-peak profile. Kept separate from Metrocount 1754 for the same reason as northbound.

series.evidence: Metrocount South from 2025-10-11, same PM-peak profile as 339 but a level that cannot be confirmed comparable.

useful: overview: showed records_per_slot above 4 in 2022-2024 and the 2021-01 and 2025-04..06 collapses at a glance
duplicates/doubled: pinpointed the exact-repeat days and confirmed all extras match
zeros(counter=True): exact start/end slots of each outage
compare(by=day): showed neighbours busy during the 2021 and 2025 outages and 542 also at 0 in 2023-06/07
network: confirmed 2025-10-23 was a feed-wide outage
hourly: confirmed direction mapping between the two counters and the changed off-peak level
not_useful: spikes: only isolated single-slot bursts of 20-40 bikes, plausibly real group rides
improve: compare: an hourly option would help for part-day outages like 2026-02-27
overview: a wide per-month layout across directions would save pivoting
add: a replacement comparison tool: for sites whose counter was swapped, the change in level against neighbours whose counters were not swapped at the same time

summary: Castlereagh St (W) south of Goulburn St had an Ecocounter (2016-05 to 2025-06) and a Metrocount (from 2025-10). The Ecocounter published every channel record twice on about 28 scattered days in 2022-2024 (drop duplicates) and had outages in 2021-01, 2023-06/07 and 2025-04..06 (missing); the Metrocount lost 2025-10-23 to a feed outage and the afternoon/evening of 2026-02-27. The Metrocount reads 25-35% higher than the Ecocounter did, but every neighbouring counter was replaced at the same time, so the two counters are kept as separate series.
